notes: Medians and min/max are across valid completed repetitions; ranges are not confidence intervals.
Actual prompt depth is cache_n + prompt_n; target_tokens is only the text-sizing target.
Ladder prefill is prompt_n / prompt_ms: cached prefix tokens are excluded from evaluated-token throughput.
A run with any ladder truncation, shrink, incomplete generation or logged error is quarantined as a whole.
Fresh-prefill results require cache_n=0; requested sizes may differ from actual prompt_n.
Real prompts allow normal early EOS (ignore_eos is not enabled); compare their actual generated lengths.
The real-prompt field ttft_ms comes from server prompt_ms; it is not end-to-end time to first token.
No synthetic-to-real correction factor is used; real prompts are summarized separately by mode and task.
Telemetry is sampled whole-device data over the whole run, including loading, plots and idle overhead.
Telemetry min/max are sampled extrema, not guaranteed instantaneous peaks; per-run means are not phase-normalized.
